value.rationale: Determines an entire natural graph-class inclusion C_k⊆G_k at all uniform multiplicities by an explicit linear-time, no-expansion map. The k=2 case covers all circle graphs (not just individual cycles) and determines their exact new-model minimum as 1 versus 2, answering a motivated quantification of a central class in the model's own proposed study of G2. This is a general structural relation with an exact sharp boundary, not an arbitrary instance or a standalone known-table recalculation.
